facts.fact: 父亲被她送回房，半路把她叫成 Isabella，到门口又让她去找 Isen
facts.anchor: at the door he asked her to go find Isen

facts.fact: 她心里已经认定 Isen 死了；她敢反抗兄弟们，是因为想到 Dagobert 会带走 Tilde
facts.anchor: Isen was dead. Had ceased to be.

facts.fact: 她提剑冲进风暴，觉得自己只配坐着、织布、等着
facts.anchor: She was fit for little except sitting, weaving, and waiting.

facts.fact: 她听着风声，觉得这场风暴像是从她自己的呼吸里生出来的
facts.anchor: As if she was the god that had made it.

facts.fact: 她把草人当成整座宫廷：祭司、Conrin、Gaisa、Egil、母亲、Tilde、Isen、Wing，最后是她自己
facts.anchor: Was Conrin, and Gaisa. Was Egil.

facts.fact: Tilde 冒雨追到校场，抓住她流血的手喊她停下
Isuire 死前留下信说明原委，Elise 把信读给父亲听，换来一顿毒打与禁读
facts.anchor: she left me a letter, telling me what happened

facts.fact: 她说出 Isuire 那件事是 Alar 做的
